questions.question: 12 g of oxygen gas contains _________ mole.
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

Mole Concept -

__
 
• The quantity one mole of a substance signifies 6.022 × 1023 number of particles of that substance which may be atoms, molecules, or ions.
 
• The quantity is a universal constant like Dozen, Gross, etc., and is known as Avogadro number, denoted by NA. after the scientist Amedeo Avogadro.
 
• Examples- In one mole of H2, there are 6.022 × 1023 molecules of hydrogen, and the number of atoms is 2 × 6.022 × 1023, as one molecule of hydrogen contains two-atom each.
 
• The mass of one mole of a substance is called its Molar Mass (M) or Atomic mass expressed in grams.
 
• The volume occupied by a mole of gas is 22.4 L at NTP, called its Molar Volume.
 
• The no. of moles (n) is calculated as =

Number of particles / Avogadro’s number.

 
• **Mole**: The mole is the amount of substance of a system that contains as many elementary entities as there are atoms in 0.012 kilograms of carbon-12; its symbol is **mol**.
 
• ​The molecular mass of any compound is calculated by adding the masses of all the constituent atoms. It is the mass of one molecule of a substance.
 
• Molar mass is defined as the mass of one mole of a substance, i.e., 6.022 × 1023 number of particles of that substance.
 
• The mass of one unit is expressed in the atomic mass unit, a.m.u, or simply 'u'. 

​Calculation:__

__
 
• 1 Mole of a Substance contains atomic mass of all atoms in the same substance.** O₂ **has an atomic mass of** 32** (16 for 1 atom of Oxygen).

⇒ 1 Mole of Oxygen has **16 × 2 = 32 grams.**

⇒ **mole = {given mass over molar mass}**

⇒ mole = 12 / 32

⇒ mole =** 0.375 mol**

Hence, the 12g of Oxygen contains **.375 mol.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The molar mass is the mass of one mole of a substance and is expressed in grams 'g'.
 
• It is the same as molecular mass only expressed in grams.

questions.question: Plants in the group _______ are commonly called algae.
questions.solution:
Option **4** is correct, i.e. __**Thallophyta**__

__**Algae**__**:**

__
 
• Algae are chlorophyll-bearing, simple, **thalloid**__, autotrophic and largely aquatic (both freshwater and marine) organisms.
 
• They occur in a variety of other habitats: moist stones, soils, and wood.
 
• Some of them also occur in association with fungi (**lichen**) and animals (e.g., on **sloth bear**). 
 
• The algae are divided into three main classes: **Chlorophyceae**, **Phaeophyceae,** and **Rhodophyceae**.

__**Bryophyta**__**:**

__
 
• Bryophytes are also called **amphibians** of the plant kingdom because these plants can live in soil but are dependent on water for sexual reproduction. Bryophytes include the various mosses and liverworts.
 
• They usually occur in damp, humid and shaded localities. They play an important role in plant succession on bare rocks/soil.

**Pteridophyta**__**:**

__
 
• They are the **first terrestrial** plants to acquire vascular tissues – xylem and phloem.
 
• Pteridophytes are used for medicinal purposes and as soil-binders.
 
• The pteridophytes are found in cool, damp, shady places though some may flourish well in sandy-soil conditions.

**Gymnosperm**__**:**

 
• The gymnosperms (gymnos : naked, Sperma: seeds) are plants in which the ovules are not enclosed by any ovary wall and remain exposed, both before and after fertilization.
 
• Gymnosperms include medium-sized trees or tall trees and shrubs.
 
• One of the gymnosperms, the giant redwood tree Sequoia is one of the tallest tree species.

questions.question: The speed of a wave in a medium is 600 m/s If 600 waves are passing through a point in the medium in 1 minute, the wavelength is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The speed of a wave in a medium = 600 m/s

Number of waves passing in 1 min = 600 waves

**Concept used:**

The wavelength of a wave = Total distance/Number of waves

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered by a wave in 1 second = 600 m.

⇒ So, Total distance covered by the wave in 60 seconds = 60 × 600 = 36000 m.

= 36000/600 = 60 m.

questions.question:
Read the given question and decide which of the following statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

**Question:**

Y, U and K are three patients waiting at a dentist. Who will the doctor attend first based on first-come-first-serve basis?

**Statements:**

1. Y arrives after K and U.

2. K arrives before U.
questions.solution:
Statement 1: Y arrives after K and U.

The person who came first can be either K or U.

Hence, statement I alone is insufficient.

Statement 2: K arrives before U.

K arrives before U but no information is given about Y

Hence, statement II alone is insufficient.

Both statement I and statement II:

Combining both the statements, it can be determined that K is first to arrive followed by U and then Y.

Hence, both statement I and statement II together are sufficient.

questions.question: A, B and C are three brothers. A’s age is the same as that of B. Sum of the ages of all the three brothers is five times the age of C. Three years ago, A’s age was three times that of C. Four years from now, what will be C’s age?
questions.solution:
Let the age of A be x, B be y and C be z.

x = y; x + y + z = 5z

→ x + y = 4z.

→ 2x = 4z; x = 2z

three years ago

x – 3 = 3 (z – 3)

→ 2z – 3 = 3z – 9 (as x = y = 2z)

→ 9 – 3 = z

→ 6 = z

Present age of C is 6 years and after 4 years from now C will be 10 years old.

Hence, 10 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Aritra had 18(2)/(7)l petrol in the fuel tank of his vehicle at the start of a journey. At the end of the journey, there was only 6(6)/(7)l petrol left in the fuel tank. What fraction of the petrol present initially was consumed during the journey?
questions.solution:
Initially, petrol in the tank = 18(2)/(7)l = 128/7

Petrol left in the tank in the end = 6(6)/(7)l = 48/7

Petrol Consumed during the journey = 128/7 - 48/7 = 80/7

Required fraction = Consumed petrol/petrol present initially

= (80/7)/(128/7) = 80/128 = 5/8

A particle is fired vertically upwards with a speed of √0.8 vₑ, where vₑ is the escape velocity. If the radius of the earth is R, then the maximum height attained by the particle will be _________.
questions.solution:
__**The conservation of energy principle is applied in both positions.**__

⇒ The energy possessed at launch is given by Ke = 1/2m v² where m is the mass of the object and V is the velocity.

⇒ V = √0.8 x Vₑ where Vₑ is the escape velocity given by √(2GM) / R, where G is the universal Gravity constant.

**⇒ Ke = 1/2 x m x 0.8 X 2GM/R**

⇒ Potential energy is possessed by the object when it is on the surface of the earth as g, gravity acts downwards until the core of the earth, hence will be negative.

⇒ Pₑₐᵣₜₕ = -GMm / R and the Potential energy at a height H, when thrown vertically up, is Pₕₑᵢgₕₜ H = -GMm/ (R + H) Where M is the mass of Earth, m is the mass of the object, R is the radius of Earth and H is the Maximum height which the object attains.

⇒ Applying the conservation of energy we have 

⇒ (- GMm / R ) + (0.8GMm/R) = ( -GMm/ (R + H))

⇒ Cancelling out G, M, m we have

⇒ (-1/R) + (0.8/R) = -1/(R+H) , Solving for H , we have

**⇒ H= 4R**

questions.question: A tank can be filled by tap A and B in 6 hrs and 3 hrs, respectively. Tap c can empty the filled tank in 5 hrs. If all the three taps are opened alternate and start from A, how much time will be taken to fill the tank completely?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tank can be filled by tap A = 6 hrs.

Tank can be filled by tap B = 3 hrs.

Tap c can empty the filled tank =5 hrs. 

**Formula used:**

Time taken by C = Total remaining work/Efficiency of C

Calculation:

According to the question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1a6a1741591bb01a471ac15bcd4dd4eeca6f50aa5a8f21a39af20eb555a3dd5.png] 

Now, all the three taps are opened

⇒ In 3 hours= 5 + 10 - 6 = 9 units

Same as, In 6 hours = 9 × 2 = 18 units

According to the question, start from A,

In 7 hours = 18 + 5 = 23 units

⇒ Remaining 30 - 23 = 7 units done by B

In (7 + 7/10) h= 30 units

⇒ Fill the tank completely = (7 + 7/10) = 77/10 h

**∴ The required answer will be 77/10 hours.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/712b7884fd0cfec4b29e560e1b73e0c25e1b8f42cfbf5536fa68e43fee32b35c.png] 

Now, according to the question,

Starting from tap A, they are opened on alternate hours,

 So, work done in 3 hours will = (5 + 10 - 6) = 9 units

work done in next 3 hours = 9 units

Here, in 6 hours work done = 9 + 9 = 18 units

Now in 7th hour A tap will do work = 5 units

Remaining work = 30 - (18 + 5) = 7 units

Now, the remaining 7 units of work will be done by tap B,

⇒ B will take 7/10 hour

So, total time = 7 + 7/10 = 77/10 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 77/10 hours.**

• Akbar was the third Mughal emperor of India and established a sprawling kingdom through military conquests, but he is known for his policy of religious tolerance.

• Akbar made marriage alliances with the Rajputs. These marriages were a result of the Rajpur policy of Akbar which was a deliberate policy and was based on the principles of enlightened self-interest, recognition of merit, justice and fair play.__

questions.question:
Given below are two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Decide which of the conclusions follow/s from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All three – sided are triangles.

II. No triangle is a circle

**Conclusion:**

I. All triangles are three – sided.

II. No circle is three – sided.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0224f84f4687f3d4a02ef6c86e6ed48d21a0dff7722cf0107cb48e02af23fde.png]

II. No circle is three – sided → True

questions.question: Which of the following belongs to Protochordates?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Amphioxus is also called lancelet belong to a group of invertebrates called protochordates which are also called Cephalochordata.**__
 
• Protochordates are animals which have a close distinction with chordates. The animals in protochordate are invertebrates.

• Protochordate is organisms** that belong to the lower chordates.**

• It is named mainly for convenience to describe **invertebrate animals that are closely related to vertebrates.**
 
• The protochordate differs chiefly from the vertebrates in not having a backbone.
